title: Graph Puzzles III.1: A Proof of Sabidussi's Compatibility Conjecture
summary: We prove Sabidussi's compatibility conjecture. Let $G$ be a finite connected multigraph in which every vertex has even degree and the minimum degree is at least four, and let $T$ be an Euler tour of $G$. The edges of $G$ can be partitioned into circuits (connected $2$-regular subgraphs) so that no circuit contains two edges used consecutively anywhere in $T$. In fact, the edges can be four-coloured so that every such pair receives different colours and every colour class has even degree at every vertex.
